# eBay UK

> eBay UK is a leading online marketplace for buying and selling electronics, fashion, collectibles, automotive parts, and more with secure authentication, local shopping options, and seller protection features.

eBay UK serves millions of buyers and sellers across the United Kingdom, offering a wide range of product categories from fashion and electronics to vehicles and collectibles. The platform emphasizes user authentication, personalized account management, and seller tools to facilitate safe transactions.

## Key Topics

- eBay UK marketplace
- Account authentication
- My eBay dashboard
- User registration
- Social login (Google, Facebook, Apple)
- Selling guides
- Deals and discounts
- Fashion category
- Local shopping
- Purchase history
- Watchlist management
- Auction bidding
- Authenticity Guarantee
- Vehicle registration
- Seller fees

## Core Marketplace

- [eBay UK Homepage](https://www.ebay.co.uk): eBay UK homepage: buy & sell electronics, cars, fashion, collectibles with top brands and free shipping
- [Best Deals on eBay](https://www.ebay.co.uk/deals): eBay deals marketplace featuring discounted electronics, automotive, refurbished items with free shipping
- [Fashion Products](https://www.ebay.co.uk/b/bn_7000259675): eBay UK Fashion category: womens, mens, kids clothing from brands like The North Face, UGG, adidas
- [Local Shopping](https://www.ebay.co.uk/vlp/local): eBay local shopping with postcode search, pickup items, and location-based deals

## Account & Authentication

- [Sign in or Register](https://signin.ebay.co.uk/ws/eBayISAPI.dll): eBay sign-in and registration page with OAuth social login (Google, Facebook, Apple)
- [Security Verification](https://signup.ebay.co.uk/pa/crte): eBay account security verification and identity authentication during signup process
- [My eBay Home](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mys/home): My eBay account home: requires authentication to access user dashboard and account features
- [Account Preferences](https://www.ebay.co.uk/d/myebay/preferences): My eBay preferences: authenticated settings page for account and notification preferences

## My eBay & User Dashboard

- [Purchase History](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/purchase): My eBay purchases: authenticated page to view purchase history and order details
- [Account Summary](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/summary): My eBay summary page: account overview requiring sign-in for purchases and activity
- [Watchlist](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/watchlist): My eBay watchlist: requires sign-in to access saved items and auction tracking
- [Bids and Offers](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/bidsoffers): My eBay bids and offers: authenticated page for managing auction bids and offers
- [Saved Items](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/saved): My eBay saved items: requires authentication to access saved products and collections
- [Messages](https://mesg.ebay.co.uk/mesgweb/ViewMessages/0): eBay messages: requires authentication to view user messages and communications

## Selling & Tools

- [Selling on eBay](https://www.ebay.co.uk/sl/sell): eBay selling guide: listing tips, fees, Authenticity Guarantee, delivery options for sellers
- [My Garage](https://www.ebay.co.uk/g/mygarage): eBay My Garage: vehicle registration tool for finding motor parts and automotive accessories

## Help & Support

- [eBay Customer Service](https://www.ebay.co.uk/help/home): eBay help center: buying guides, selling guides, FAQs, returns, refunds, account management

## Optional

- [Recently Viewed Items](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/rvi): My eBay recently viewed items: requires login to access browsing history
- [Saved Searches](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/savedsearches): My eBay saved searches: authenticated page to manage saved search queries and alerts
- [Saved Sellers](https://www.ebay.co.uk/mye/myebay/savedsellers): My eBay saved sellers: requires login to access favorite sellers and seller information
